fact: The national statistics strategy 2020-2024 (August 2020) lists weak exploitation of administrative sources as a weakness and sets as a result that exploitation of administrative data sources is improved, while noting routine collection yields yearbooks on health, culture, justice and education.
title: Stratégie nationale de développement de la statistique (SNDS) 2020-2024
publisher: Ministère de la Planification du Développement et de la Coopération
